note: Targets and required evidence, not live capabilities or authority. No action triggered by this file.
prerequisite: G4 release acceptance; preserve any stricter existing mobile-plugin and governance requirements until explicitly reconciled by owner

stages.admission: invite-only adults; first acceptance and one private consented Passport record; expand only after review
server-enforced capacity, explicit cohorts, reviewer backlog and abuse limits; stop before capacity exceeded

stages.burst_evidence: disposable non-production synthetic test; no production stress, real messages, real registrations, personal data or paid service; prove no active admission above approved capacity

gates.name: Independent first cohort
gates.required_evidence: Actual consented distinct adult operators and reviewed eligible submissions; real pause/revoke proof

gates.name: Mobile and no-MCP intake
gates.required_evidence: Supported mobile plugin path independently accepted under existing gate; no-account fallback independently tested

evidence.result: Static /capacity fallback built; no mobile plugin acceptance or genuine independent participant.

gates.name: Capacity controlled registration and work
gates.required_evidence: Both direct MCP and web register share atomic server-side admission budget, reviewer/assignment ceiling; exhausted/unknown fails safely; current per-fingerprint 5/hour alone is insufficient

evidence.scope: disposable PostgreSQL fixture; NOT production or HTTP load acceptance
evidence.result: 10,000 synthetic insert attempts, 20 concurrent sessions, 4 admitted, 9,996 deferred, 1 existing, total cap 5, zero over-cap admissions. Full/unknown outcomes surfaced in draft browser and MCP clients; static overflow page added.
evidence.remaining: Actual hosted relation/RPC/schema privileges, least-privilege trigger owner, durable retry protection, work and review ceilings, isolated hosted acceptance.

gates.name: Burst interest and privacy
gates.required_evidence: 10,000 synthetic interest requests with bounded writes, explicit consent, minimization/retention/deletion, retry/idempotency, overload status and no participant impersonation

evidence.scope: disposable PostgreSQL fixture; NOT production or HTTP load acceptance
evidence.result: 10,000 distinct synthetic interest tickets, 100 duplicate retries, one overflow correctly deferred, withdrawal and expiration purge tested, node count unchanged. No-data overflow page draft build passed.
evidence.remaining: HTTP endpoint/load rehearsal, proof-of-possession, abuse limits, consent/withdrawal UI, actual retention/backups/provider limitations and independently reviewed privacy acceptance. No new real data collection.

gates.name: Governed Foundry and operational continuity
gates.required_evidence: Real independently reviewed artifact, canonical leases, hard provider cap, verified monitoring and incident rollback

gates.name: Security and data governance
gates.required_evidence: Issue 68 protected main with separate identity, issue 96 tested deletion/revocation, no unsafe credential disclosure, security review

gates.name: Impact Passport
gates.required_evidence: One actual accepted contribution and separately consented private record; portable badge, verification/revocation and actual user-controlled sharing tested; no partnership claim

gates.name: MOTHER account and content
gates.required_evidence: Actual blue check on finalized account; clear AI identity; owner-approved evidence-backed initial posts and verified manual posting path

evidence.scope: source-ledger-grounded private review draft; not live posting or approval
evidence.result: New pinned introduction and six-post sequence cover four historical corrections with causal caveats; all estimated lengths <=280.
evidence.remaining: Actual account profile, blue check, owner review, source recheck, composer length and authorized publication path.

gates.name: Engagement scope
gates.required_evidence: If AI replies are intended, actual prior written explicit approval from X, compliant opt-in behavior and automated account label connected to human account; otherwise no automated replies

gates.name: Funding and incident response
gates.required_evidence: Verified recurring support mechanism, operator/tax disclosure and accounting, refund/cancel path, approved budget and review capacity; no payment test without separate approval

gates.name: Explicit release decision
gates.required_evidence: Independent review of current evidence and human owner GO for bounded launch; stop switch and named accountable maintainer
